key.name: start-mode
key.description: Start machines with a window (separate front-end) or headless. Both modes allow attaching or detaching the window later.

key.name: stop-mode
key.description: Action used when a machine is switched off: acpipowerbutton, savestate or poweroff.

key.name: refresh-interval
key.description: Seconds between virtual machine state refreshes.

key.name: show-running-count
key.description: Show the number of running machines next to the panel icon.

key.name: show-window-toggle
key.description: Show a Show window / Hide window entry for running headless machines.
